name: Padelta
geoNote: Cocody Danga / Palais des Congrès corridor — Rue des Jasmins not separately geocoded
description: Padelta is Abidjan’s large indoor padel club in Cocody Danga — five FIP-standard covered courts with gym and café, open daily morning through evening. A clear recommendation when you want destination padel in Côte d’Ivoire rather than a single neighbourhood pitch. Reserve via WhatsApp or the Padelta app before peak hours.

name: WePadel Marcory

description: WePadel Marcory offers three covered padel courts in Marcory Résidentiel with a dedicated booking app for year-round play. A solid recommendation when you want Marcory padel distinct from the Ace padel OSM pin and from Cocody’s Padelta. Confirm the exact entrance in the app before you travel.
